This plot is rented, and I do not have much money to buy many inputs, so I will manage it in a simple way. Here in Tabora we depend on the rains, and for this plot I will use local seed and my family labor more than purchased inputs. I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use chemicals unless there is a serious problem, which is not my plan now.
